lines.text: I hear you everywhere
In the room before the day begins
I hear you everywhere
In the pause between the closing doors
Echoes in my head
echoes in my head
Every word returns, then turns to air
Echoes in my head, echoes in my head
I reach for you and find the empty chair
Even sounds like you
A breath against the window pane
I keep the little things you knew
And let them pass through me again
you everywhere
Though the rooms have changed their names
I hear you everywhere
Like a fire with no flame
Echoes in my head, echoes in my head
Every word returns, then turns to air
Echoes in my head, echoes in my head
I reach for you and find the empty chair
Ah, ah-ah
And
nothing.
